item.title: NCAA MEN’S LACROSSE: Syracuse’s Leo calls game in overtime at Penn
item.description: PHILADELPHIA, Pa. — The No. 7 Syracuse Orange men’s lacrosse team looked finished midway through the third quarter Sunday afternoon at Franklin Field. Down four goals and struggling to gain possession, the Orange instead delivered their most complete stretch of the season, rallying for a 9-8 overtime victory against the No. 19 Penn Quakers. item.title: NCAA WOMEN’S BASKETBALL: Orange down Boston College on Senior Day
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. — The Syracuse Orange women’s basketball team emphatically closed the regular season Sunday, rolling past Boston College Eagles 90-65 on Senior Day at the JMA Wireless Dome.
